checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Exactly five separate 4:5 portrait images, no extra slides
must.why: Five images, no extras, but all are square 1:1, not 4:5.

must.item: Five tips verbatim, one per slide, in order
must.why: Wording and order match; only capitalization differs, and the user wrote the tips in lowercase.

must.item: Each slide has an illustration relevant to its tip
must.why: Desk, phone with bell, checkbox, stopwatch and coffee cup. The checkbox is small and only loosely fits 'one task'.

must.item: Clean blue-and-white design, readable unclipped text
must.why: The background is sage green, not blue and white. The text is readable and unclipped.

faults.what: Palette is sage green and navy, not blue and white.
Inconsistent layout: the headline size, position and illustration size vary between slides. Slide 3's checkbox is tiny and leaves large empty space. Slide 1's desk is small and low.
The desk on slide 1 is full of clutter, which contradicts 'clear your desk'.
The background shade varies slightly from slide to slide.

summary: Five clean, correctly spelled square slides came out with relevant line drawings, but they are not 4:5, have no numbering, and use a green palette instead of blue and white.
